applyTo: "**/*.{md,json,tempoflow,yml,yaml}"

# Documentation and Data Instructions

- Write all prose and metadata in English, except proper names.
- Keep Markdown compatible with GitHub and Obsidian.
- Use relative links and descriptive link text.
- Do not claim that an unimplemented or untested feature works.
- Preserve valid JSON and the approved preset semantics.
- Distinguish normative requirements from proposals and future work.
